title: Intervention profile extraction spec (schema version 1)
description: Inputs of `model-pipeline interventions extract`: the base graph, two contrasting prompt sets, the candidate sites and the direction method. Paths are relative to the spec file. Machine-specific locations (model snapshot, cache) are command-line options, never part of the spec. See docs/interventions/extraction.md.

model.description: Cache model name (the capture cache directory under the cache root).

base_model_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the base model.onnx, as the model package's asset lock records it. A site mapping must exist for it.

graph.description: The base graph, relative to the model snapshot root.

pooling.description: response_mean: mean of the residual over the response tokens. last_token: the residual at the last token before <|im_end|>.

direction_method.description: mean_difference_pca: direction 1 is the normalized mean of the paired differences; directions 2..rank are the top principal components of the paired differences with direction 1 projected out.

scale.description: The per-direction scale s written for every direction of every selected site.

folds.description: Cross-validation folds over pairs: separability is measured on held-out pairs only.

path.description: JSON lines file, one object per line: {"id", "prompt", "response"}. Relative to the spec file.
